description:
Bernie Rose, an aspiring writer who worked as a waiter, met the perfect rich man Ian Bentley and has been living together for n years. Bernie wants to live happily with Ian, but Ian, who wants a child, is dissatisfied with Bernie's immature behavior, and Bernie, who is unemployed, thinks that Ian will acknowledge him only if he succeeds at work, and their relationship gradually grows apart. Meanwhile, Bernie's ex-girlfriend Lisa is a reliable best friend who listens to Bernie's worries and gives him advice, but she is not very good at solving her own love problems. Bernie gets a college classmate who understands him, and Lisa gets a decent man who seems to have a secret...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
